proposal.reason: Primary change is in transport/P2P-SHM connection behavior: setup synchronization and progress accounting, on-demand IPC registered-address handling, and shared-memory descriptor lifecycle for P2P CE control buffers. Also includes a substantive topology-path policy change (ncclTopoCheckNet and NET_DISABLE_INTRA) that computes GPU↔NET bandwidth and steers intra-node transport eligibility, which falls under device-topology.
